ora·ïto — projects — Curling

Curling

Category Furniture
Brand Dunlopillo
Collection Dunlopillo
Year 2012

The round sofa. Small sofa for two, very round, very soft, the Curling finds its ideal place in all young and modern interiors. By creating a line of “new generation” seats for Dunlopillo, Ora-Ito wanted to invent a modular and easy-to-use collection: sofa, lounge, pouf, convertible devoid of any complex handling. From small to large interiors, models that suit all lifestyles.

simplicity is
